div.div:
PK = primary key FK = foreign key UQ = unique
All columns are NOT NULL unless marked NULL. All timestamps default to CURRENT_TIMESTAMP.
Each project has exactly one user; each session has exactly one project. Parents may have zero or more children.
Foreign keys use NO ACTION on delete: parent rows with children cannot be deleted.
